key_insight: For financial time-series regression, QNN performance is driven more by circuit design choices—especially gate type, arrangement, and entanglement structure—than by parameter count alone.
engineering_relevance: The study offers practical design rules for building and benchmarking QNNs on near-term quantum hardware, highlighting which architectures are most accurate and most noise-resilient.
method: Compared encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, depths, and cost functions.
Evaluated forecasting accuracy, computational cost, convergence, and hardware noise on IQM Emerald.
evidence_signal: Across the benchmark, the best QNN reached an R² of 0.985 on GBP/USD forecasting and outperformed a classical BiLSTM baseline.
watch_item: Results on near-term hardware may degrade substantially because gate errors and decoherence remain major barriers, so circuit depth and gate choice must be carefully controlled.
paper_title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
